newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jordan's king puts off U.S. visit, returns home.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king puts off U.S. visit, returns home.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein cut short a visit to Spain and put off a planned trip to Washington on Thursday to return home after one of his soldiers killed seven Israeli schoolgirls on Jordanian soil, Israel Radio said.
The radio said a military aide, Brigadier-General Ali Shukri, had told it the king would put off his visit to the United States and return immediately to Jordan.
The king was in Spain on his way to Washington for talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton.
The king called Israel's president Ezer Weizman to express shock and anger at the killings, Shukri told the radio.

"His Majesty expressed his feelings of shock, pain and anger at the murder committed earlier this morning on Jordanian territory which resulted in the death or injury of a number of innocent and unarmed Israeli guests to Jordan, most of whom were children students," he said.
